Jason Holder picked up a fifer to begin his stint post-captaincy while Kemar Roach once again bowled his heart out for a 3-wicket haul. So. it's advantage West Indies at the moment and they will be looking to firm their grip on this Test match by batting out the whole day today.

Are you ready for more grinding? Not just Sri Lanka, we all should be ready for some typical Test action. 13 runs in 13 overs last evening from West Indies and it's just an indication that they are looking to bat carefully, take their time and build partnerships. The hosts will be aiming to tire out the Lankan bowlers and then feast on them later in the evening. On that note, allow us to welcome you all for the coverage of the second day. Stay tuned for more...
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...

What's in store for Day 2? Will Sri Lanka be able to make some early inroads? Or will West Indies continue to pile on the runs and misery on Sri Lanka? To find out how will Day 2 unfold and who will end up taking the honours. Join us on 22nd March 2021 for all the action on Day 2. The action begins at 1000 Local (1400 GMT). Till then cheers and take care.

Jason Holder is caught for a quick chat. Jason says that it is good to be back playing for the national team. Tells that he is glad to have put his team in the front seat. Says that there was something for the bowler on the wicket. Adds they started really well early on. Mentions that they put pressure on the top order and that put pressure on the lower half of the Sri Lankan batting. Wants to keep going ahead in this game.

Sri Lankan bowlers tried really hard in these 13 overs but failed to break the opening stand as Campbell and Brathwaite were happy blocking everything thrown at them. They will now look to make this stand a massive one.

Earlier in the day, after opting to field West Indies were all over Sri Lankan batsmen as they troubled them with disciplined bowling and accurate lines and lengths which helped them take wickets at regular intervals to skittle the Lankans for 169. The star was Jason Holder as he brought the 8th 5-wicket haul in Tests. Roach had 3 to his name.  With the bat for Sri Lanka, Lahiru Thirimanne was the only one who managed a fifty-plus score. The next best was Niroshan Dickwella as the rest of them failed miserably.

That caps off a perfect day for West Indies, both with the bat as well as the ball. They would be a happy bunch with their performance. All thanks to Jason Holder and Kemar Roach who rattled the visitors with the ball. Their batters have done well to negotiate the threat in these few overs. And now, Sri Lanka have an uphill task to do from here after they folded for a mere 169 runs.
Short and outside off, Campbell gets across and blocks it solidly. With that, it is STUMPS ON DAY 1.
Sharp turn! Shortish and just outside off, spinning away. Kraigg pokes it towards the gully region and takes one.
Floated around off, Kraigg comes on the front foot and blocks calmly.
Short and wide outside off, slapped straight to the man at point.
Dropped slightly short and around off, it spins away. Punched to the man at cover.
Floated ball around off and middle, Brathwaite gets forward and blocks.
Lasith Embuldeniya is on now. This could be the last over of the day. Can he do some magic?
Wide outside off, left alone.
Good leave! Or maybe a risky leave. Length ball outside off, it shapes back in sharply. Campbell covers his stumps and allows it to go to the keeper.
Angled in from middle and leg, goes down the leg side. Left alone.
Full and around off, kept out.
Good length and around off and middle, blocked.
Shortish and on the pads, Campbell looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pad and goes to fine leg. They cross. But the umpire feels that he didn't offer any shot. Dead ball called.
Full ball around middle and leg, tucked on the leg side. Lakmal oversteps.
Very full ball around off, blocked.
Shortish and outside off, kept out.
Another quick single. Shortish in length and around off, this time Campbell taps it in front of the cover region for one.
Quick single! Fullish and just outside off, Kraigg pushes it towards the cover region for one.
Around off on a length, solidly blocked by the skipper.
Full and outside off, pushed to the mid off region.
Around off on a good length. Kept out.
Shortish and around middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, poked towards point.
Full and around off, solidly blocked.
Fullish and outside off, angling in. Campbell looks to drive but ends up getting it off the inner half. Goes to mid-wicket. A dot.
Was there some bat? Shortish and just outside off, Campbell looks to defend but the ball hits him high on the pad.
Fullish and around middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing. Lakmal has overstepped. No Ball called.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Banged short on middle and leg. Brathwaite sits under it.
Shortish and around middle, kept out.
Fuller and around off, kept out.
Full and around off, flicked to mid-wicket. Good connection but straight to mid-wicket.
He is right on the moeny! A length ball around off, rises a touch as Brathwaite hops and defends.
Dushmantha Chameera to have a go now. Can he strike for Sri Lanka before the close of the play?
Good length and outside off, Campbell offers no shot.
Shortish and just outside off, poked on the off side.
Outside off, left alone.
back of a length ball angled in. Campbell looks to work it on the leg side but ends up getting an inside edge on the pad.
Another one which is too wide outside off on a good length. Campbell lets it go to the keeper.
In the channel outside off, it is left alone by Campbell.
Length ball around middle, kept out.
Length ball around off, Brathwaite gets forward and blocks.
In the channel outisde off, Kraigg lets it go to the keeper.
Good length and around middle, tucked on the leg side for nothing.
Fuller and around off, kept out.
Fullish and outside off, Brathwaite lets it be.
Outside off on a good length. Left alone.
Full and wide outsidde off, driven to the cover region.
Short but down the leg side. Campbell looks to pull but misses to connect.
Fullish and just outside off, poked towards the man at point.
Another one outside off, left alone once again.
Length ball outside off, Campbell makes a leave to begin the fresh over.
Full and on middle, flicked to fine leg for a run.
Angled in from outside off, Campbell is confident about his off stump as he allows the ball to go to the keeper. Good leave.
Good running! A fuller ball on off and middle, Campbell flicks it through mid-wicket and scampers back for two.
Around off on a length, played back to the bowler.
Good length and just outside off, John comes on the front foot and pushes it towards the off side.
Length ball just outside off, punched towards the cover region.
Shortish and on middle and leg, Campbell looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pad. The ball rolls on the leg side and they cross for a leg bye.
Angled in from outside off, left alone.
Wide outside off, left alone.

Big appeal for LBW but that was going down. A fuller ball on the pads, Campebell looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. A loud appeal follows but the umpire is not interested. The Lankans aren't too keen either.
Short and wide outside off, Campbell punches it through covers and gets a brace.
Fullish and outside off, left alone.
Length ball on middle, nudged off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, KB makes a watchful leave.
Campbell is off the mark too. Length and sliding on leg, John helps it to square leg for a run.
Full and down leg, Campbell looks to clip it fine to the leg side but fails to get wood on the ball.
Length ball angled on off. straightening off the surface this time as John looks to defend it but is beaten on the outside edge.
Full and around off, Campbell blocks it off the back foot to mid off.
On off, defended to mid off this time. A maiden to start for Vishwa Fernando
Length ball going away from Brathwaite, Kraigg watches and then leaves it.
Length and around off, Kraigg pushes it to the off side this time.
BEATEN! Full and going across, Brathwaite, Kraigg looks to poke at it tamely off the back foot but the away movement means that it goes past the outside edge.
Length ball around middle, Kraigg nudges it to the leg side.
Full and around off, stroked to the off side this time.
Who will bowl from the other end? Vishwa Fernando it will be with the ball.
Kraigg Brathwaite and West Indies are underway! Full and sliding on leg, Braithwaite gets inside the line and then clips it to fine leg for a single.
Length ball angled in on off, Brathwaite defends it out with ease.
Good length and around off, Kraigg blocks it out off the back foot this time.
Full and swinging into Kraigg Brathwaite who flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, Kraigg this time does not offer a shot to it.
Swing early on for Lakmal. He lands one around off and gets it to shape away from Brathwaite who comes on the front foot to defend but is beaten on the outside edge.
